Drivers.name: Hyperscaler capex
Drivers.thesis: Big-4 cloud capex funds most data center GPU demand; sustained growth extends NVIDIA's revenue runway, a cut shortens it.
Drivers.notes: Share of price left blank: needs the valuation work from a thesis session.

Drivers.name: Rubin ramp
Drivers.thesis: A smooth Rubin ramp keeps NVIDIA's product cadence ahead of custom silicon and protects pricing through the Blackwell-to-Rubin transition.
Drivers.notes: Mechanism: gross margin (D4) sits on it. Rubin share is not known to be disclosed; tracked as a Disclosure step (House Rule).

Drivers.name: Non-hyperscale demand
Drivers.thesis: AI clouds, sovereign, enterprise and AI-native buyers (NVIDIA's 'AI Clouds, Industrial & Enterprise' platform) diversify demand beyond the big hyperscalers and reduce customer concentration.
Drivers.notes: Measured by NVIDIA's ACIE market platform, disclosed since Q1 FY27 (R1, R10). ACIE also includes hyperscalers buying through AI clouds.

Drivers.name: Gross margin
Drivers.thesis: Margin holding near guidance through product transitions converts revenue growth into earnings.

Drivers.name: China (base case zero)
Drivers.thesis: Any resumption of meaningful data center sales to China is upside to a base case that assumes none.

Drivers.name: Balance sheet quality
Drivers.thesis: Inventory, receivables and supply commitments growing faster than revenue would signal demand pull-forward or financing risk.
Drivers.notes: Q2 FY27: DSO rose to 60 days on extended payment terms with large customers; supply and capacity commitments rose to $279B (R1, R10).

Signals.name: Big-4 hyperscaler capex (AMZN+GOOG+MSFT+META cash purchases of property and equipment), $B per calendar quarter
Signals.anchor: Thesis rule (draft 2026-11-09): Big-4 capex at least holds at the prior quarter's level; red after a fall of more than 10% QoQ. A guidance-based path can replace it once each company's capex guidance is checked.
Signals.notes: Feed: EDGAR PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment (Amazon: PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets, gross of proceeds). Quarter = year-to-date minus prior year-to-date. Excludes finance leases (Microsoft and Meta add material finance leases; Amazon reports purchases gross of proceeds). Microsoft's fiscal year ends June: its Q2 CY = 10-K full year minus 9-month YTD.

Signals.name: TSMC monthly revenue, YoY %
Signals.anchor: Thesis (draft 2026-11-09): YoY growth implied by TSMC's own quarterly revenue guidance at its stated exchange rate (Q3 2026 +46.1%, Q4 2026 +62.0%); tolerance 15% covers month-to-month swings.
Signals.notes: Feed: TSMC monthly revenue release (~10th of each month). Broad AI and smartphone proxy, not NVIDIA-only.

Signals.name: Rubin share of Data Center revenue, %
Signals.anchor: Management commentary on the ramp; set once a figure is disclosed.
Signals.notes: Not disclosed in Q2 FY27 (Rubin was being introduced in Q3: 'Vera Rubin... ramping into full production', R2; inventory built 'as we prepare for the introduction of Vera Rubin in the third quarter', R10). The Q3 FY27 call on 2026-11-17 is the first natural disclosure occasion: if it passes without a figure, add a Scoring log row with Withheld = Y (House Rule).

Signals.name: AI Clouds, Industrial & Enterprise (ACIE) Data Center revenue, $B
Signals.anchor: Thesis rule (draft 2026-11-09): ACIE grows in line with NVIDIA's revenue guide; ACIE grew 25% QoQ and 138% YoY in Q2 FY27.
Signals.notes: Feed: EDGAR Revenues with ProductOrServiceAxis=AICloudsIndustrialEnterpriseMember. Trap: ACIE includes hyperscalers buying through AI clouds; reclassifications between platforms recur.
Signals.definition_change: 2026-05-20: new market-platform presentation (Hyperscale / ACIE / Edge Computing), prior periods recast. 2026-08-26: one company moved from ACIE to Hyperscale, prior periods recast (Q1 FY27 ACIE 37.377 as first reported, 32.196 recast). Use the recast series from the latest filing.

Signals.name: GAAP gross margin, %
Signals.anchor: Company guidance: Q3 FY27 GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin 74.0% plus or minus 50 bp (R2). Tolerance 0.7% of a 74% base is about 0.5 points, so YELLOW = inside the guided band and RED = below it (owner decision 2026-11-07; was 2%, about 1.5 points).
Signals.notes: Feed: EDGAR GrossProfit / Revenues. GAAP and non-GAAP guidance are identical this quarter (R2). Provisions for inventory and excess purchase obligations cost 0.8 points in Q2 FY27 (R1).

Signals.name: China data center export licence milestones
Signals.anchor: Base case is zero China data center revenue (company guidance assumption, to verify).

Signals.name: Inventory, $B
Signals.anchor: Thesis view: inventory growing faster than revenue for two quarters is the bear signal; base case from the prior quarter scaled by guided revenue growth.
Signals.notes: Feed: EDGAR InventoryNet. Q2 FY27 build explained by the Vera Rubin introduction (R10): a timing build, not necessarily a demand warning. No consensus exists.

Signals.name: Days sales outstanding, days
Signals.notes: Company-stated DSO (R10); our calculation AccountsReceivableNetCurrent / Revenues x 91 gives 59.6 (Q2) and 45.4 (Q1). Rise explained by 'extended payment terms on large, multi-quarter agreements with certain investment-grade customers'.

Signals.name: Supply and capacity commitments, $B
Signals.anchor: Ratio to next-quarter revenue guide; the metric's own history.
Signals.notes: 10-Q risk factors and Note 10 (R1): 'increased our supply and capacity commitments from $119 billion last quarter to $279 billion as of July 26, 2026'. Mostly memory per secondary reports (not confirmed in the filing text read).
